_comment: The Mudlet-side contract this package is written against, pinned by blob SHA.
mudlet-contract-watch.yml compares these against Mudlet's development branch and
opens an issue when one moves, so a change to the stt.* bridge is noticed here
rather than by a player whose microphone stopped working.
Update a SHA once the change behind it has been reviewed and this package either
needs nothing or has been adjusted. Leaving one stale is what keeps the issue open.
Paths are watched, not the whole repository: Mudlet lands dozens of commits a week
and almost none of them touch this API.
